sources.entry: pyLoad - Lightweight, customizable and remotely manageable downloader for 1-click-hosting sites like rapidshare.com or uploaded.to. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Python

summary.one_liner: pyLoad is a free, pure-Python download manager with a web UI and plugin system, aimed mainly at one-click hosters and cloud drives.
summary.what_it_does: pyLoad automates downloads from one-click hosting sites, cloud drives, and other sources through a plugin system that includes hoster, decrypter, and addon plugins. It supports premium accounts, captcha-solving services, and link decryption, according to the README. It provides a browser-based web interface and can run headless on servers, NAS devices, or desktops. A REST API is documented with an OpenAPI/Swagger UI, and the README describes generating client code from that spec. Installation is via pip (pyload-ng), and Docker usage is also described. The README says it is designed for extensibility and low resource usage.
use_cases: headless download server on a NAS
remotely manage downloads through a web browser
build a client app against a download manager REST API
notable: Plugin-driven design with hundreds of hosters, decrypters, and addons according to the README
Web interface plus OpenAPI-documented REST API with Swagger UI
Runs headless as a daemon on servers, NAS devices, or desktops
caveats: README states the project is in pre-release phase with no stable release yet; development releases are not recommended for production
Default web login is pyload/pyload and the README strongly advises changing it on first start
Python releases below 3.9 are not supported
